name: footer-split-panel
title: Split panel footer
description: A footer in two panels: an inverted card with the pitch and one action, and the link columns on the plain page beside it.
docs: Pass brand, statement, an action and social ({ label, href, icon }) for the card, the columns for the page beside it, and legal with legalLinks for the row beneath both. Inside the card the primary pair is turned round and the neutral tokens follow, so a plain Button or a focus ring is already the right way round, and a hairline sits just inside its edge. On a phone the card comes first and the columns follow two across. Profiles open in a new tab and say so; linkAs renders the internal links with your router's Link; labels translates the fixed words. No state of its own, so it renders on the server.
